ideas.pitch: A command-line intelligence tool designed to rapidly analyze binary files, identify hidden strings, and automate basic Jeopardy-style CTF recon.
ideas.problem_statement: Participants will face a variety of cybersecurity challenges that require logical thinking, technical knowledge, investigation, and creativity in a Jeopardy-style CTF.
ideas.title: CTFFinder CLI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves the solo time crunch by automating routine enumeration tasks, freeing up the single participant to focus on difficult exploitation vectors.
